 O R D E R

The application is filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (in short, 'Code'),
for an order of pre-arrest bail.

2. The petitioner is apprehending arrest in Crime No.1308/2023 of the Parappanangadi Police Station, Malappuram district, registered against him for allegedly committing the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66D of the Information Technology Act.

3. Heard; Smt. Anjana Kannath, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Smt.Seetha S.,
the learned Senior Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent 4.
The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that as on 20.12.2023, the petitioner is not arrayed as an accused in the above crime.
In the light of the above submission, the bail application is closed.

It is made clear that, if the presence of the BAIL APPL. NO.11382 OF 2023 petitioner is required by Parappanangadi Police with regard to the allegations made in the bail application, he shall be issued with a notice under Section 41A of the Code, if the offence alleged against him is punishable for less than seven years.
Sd/-
